an4.203:3.3: And they steal, and encourage others to steal;
an4.203:3.4: And they engage in sexual misconduct, and encourage others to do the same;
an4.203:3.5: And they lie, and encourage others to lie;
an4.203:3.6: And they use backbiting speech, and encourage others to do the same;
an4.203:3.7: And they use harsh speech, and encourage others to do the same;
an4.203:3.8: And they use nonsensical speech, and encourage others to do the same.
an4.203:5.3: And they refrain from stealing, and encourage others to refrain from stealing;
an4.203:5.4: And they refrain from sexual misconduct, and encourage others to refrain from it;
an4.203:5.5: And they refrain from lying, and encourage others to refrain from it;
an4.203:5.6: And they refrain from backbiting speech, and encourage others to refrain from it;
an4.203:5.7: And they refrain from harsh speech, and encourage others to refrain from it;
an4.203:5.8: And they refrain from nonsensical speech, and encourage others to refrain from it.
